title: Little Ideals
description: This is a modpack designed for bringing back old features like no hunger or mending, and focus on surviving the night. With new features like no durability and inventory management.
body:
# Little Ideals
-----------
This modpack is to bring back older ideas/gameplay to minecraft and get rid of newer changes that overpowers or is not needed for minecraft. The key idea of this modpack is to challange the player during night and provide enhanced building and fortification during the day. This modpack also adds little touches and enhancements that are help the **( survive during the night ) to ( fortify during the day )** and just general ambience.
## What it removes
-----------
* Sleeping in beds
* Hunger
* Tool durability
* Phantoms
* Mending
* Advancements
* WEAK MOBS ( This is peak trust )
## What it adds
-----------
* More particles
* Better stars
* Better clouds
* Furnature
* Better snow
* Old world gen
* Stackable potions
* Falling trees
* Vein miner
* Dynamic lights
* More ambience
* Fashion
* Carts
* Void fog
## What it changes
* Defaults to beta world gen
* Explosions
* Snow
* Textures
* Rain
* Sound Direction
* Mob AI
* 2D Items
* Force place by default
